displayName: Firebase Hosting for the Flutter web app
summary: Deploys the web build to Firebase Hosting: preview channel first, live after typing the project id, from a clean commit that analyzes and tests. Every path serves the app; security headers on every response; a report-only content security policy to enforce once clean.

firebaseProjectId.label: Firebase project ID
firebaseProjectId.help: The Google Cloud / Firebase project this application uses, e.g. acme-crm-prod. It must already exist with Firebase enabled.
